description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).
No-LayerNorm 2-layer circuit: relative-offset heads detect whole-word keywords (boundary-delimited, <=9 letters); uniform pooling counts them; hand-set per-class vote table.
Adds question-initial word detectors; each vote on a word that starts the question gets an extra 0.5x bonus (START_BONUS=0.5).
Fixes double-counting of question-initial words (any-position detector needs a real boundary); question-initial words get (1+0.5)x vote; lower weights for how/is/are; more HUM nouns.
V2 plus plural and extra LOC/NUM/ENTY nouns; year/years raised to 3.0; 'what'/'which' default weight lowered to 0.8.
V3 plus two-word detectors (how many/long/old..., what is/kind/type, who was/is) with their own votes; detectors fire only at real word boundaries.

BigramV4 with ENTY class bias lowered to -1.0 (ENTY was over-predicted for 'what' questions).
BigramV4 with START_BONUS=0: question-initial words get the same vote as any other occurrence.
BigramV4 plus ~200 extra content words (people/roles, places, quantities/units, explanation nouns, animals/food/arts/materials) with unigram votes; START_BONUS=0.5.
